hooks.title: MCC · Manual diamond button
hooks.description: Tap ♦ 9 inside MCC to open manual control; confirmed root only in HookLab. No VIP, banner or automatic refills.

hooks.title: Neo Store · Open in ObtainX
hooks.description: Neo Store 1.3.3/1304 only. Show ObtainX-branded header icon on a verified app page; tap to open ObtainX import preview. No auto imports.

hooks.title: Droid-ify · Add to ObtainX
hooks.description: Droid-ify 0.7.8/780 only. Adds one native toolbar action after validating the current app and repository. No host data writes.

hooks.title: Word Master · Night filter (experimental)
hooks.description: Word Master 0.6.10 only. Dims the Unity gameplay view without recoloring in-game textures. Fully opt-in; restart the game to apply or remove.

hooks.title: ChatGPT · Code-block action diagnostic (experimental)
hooks.description: Read-only, opt-in diagnostics for ChatGPT 1.2026.321/2632128. Observes native CodeBlock/CopyButton renders and callback/clipboard parity; no command execution, message storage, Termux dispatch or raw text logs.

hooks.title: ChatGPT · Run code in Termux (experimental)
hooks.description: Adds a separate native Run action beside Copy; review and confirm in HookLab. No clipboard dependency or automatic execution.
